Definition: a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal
BiblicalUsage: 1) breath, spirit; 1a) breath (of God); 1b) breath (of man); 1c) every breathing thing; 1d) spirit (of man)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
